adventurers.description: Graceful Long Sword duelist who hides her blade in a shamisen. A Perfect Evade fills her Spirit Gauge in one go, fuelling relentless Spirit Slash chains.
adventurers.descriptionFa: شمشیرزن خوش‌دست و سریعی که تیغه‌اش را توی ساز شامیسن قایم می‌کند! کافی است یک جاخالی تمیز (Perfect Evade) بدهی تا نوار روحش یک‌جا پر شود و بعد با زنجیرهٔ Spirit Slash هیولا را رها نکند.

adventurers.description: Highly mobile archer (free from the launch event). His piercing arrows gain hits as the charge level rises, and Thunder Coatings turn every volley into lightning.
adventurers.descriptionFa: کماندار فرز و پرتحرکی که از رویداد لانچ رایگان می‌گیری‌اش. تیرهای سوراخ‌کننده‌اش هرچه بیشتر شارژ شوند، دفعات بیشتری به هیولا می‌خورند و با پوشش رعدی، هر رگبارش می‌شود یک صاعقهٔ کامل.

ultimate.description: Enters Thunderclap state for 15 s and instantly reloads 2 Thunder Coatings.

adventurers.description: Steam-powered Hammer bruiser — the roster's only Ice Adventurer. Charged attacks build Steam and Core Energy, cashed out in the explosive Steam Skyrender.
adventurers.descriptionFa: تنها ادونچرر یخی بازی که با یک چکش بخارپاور می‌جنگد. ضربه‌های شارژی‌اش بخار و انرژی هسته جمع می‌کنند و این انرژی در ضربهٔ انفجاری Steam Skyrender یک‌جا خالی می‌شود.

skills.description: Spends full Core Energy for explosive burst.

adventurers.description: Endures hits to raise his Fervor Level, then releases earth-shattering charged blows (free from the launch event). Fervor falls if he stops attacking — never let up.
adventurers.descriptionFa: غول مهربان بازی که از رویداد لانچ رایگان می‌گیری‌اش! ضربه خوردن برایش نعمت است؛ سطح شورش (Fervor) بالا می‌رود و ضربه‌های شارژی‌اش زمین را می‌لرزانند. فقط یادت باشد: اگر دست از حمله بکشی، شورش می‌خوابد.

adventurers.description: Perfect Guards and parries build up to 3 Sharpness stacks — at a full red glow he spends them on a devastating Rending Sweep. Free SR.
adventurers.descriptionFa: نیزه‌دار آرام و مطمئنی که با گارد و پریِ بی‌نقص تا سه لایه تیزی (Sharpness) جمع می‌کند؛ وقتی تیغه‌اش سرخ شد، با Rending Sweep همه را یک‌جا خرج می‌کند و هیولا را تکه‌پاره می‌کند. جزو SRهای رایگان است.

ultimate.description: Parry stance that shields nearby allies, then a counter that always staggers.

adventurers.description: Airborne gunner. Bouncy Dash launches her skyward for rapid fire, Concentration stacks feed Pressurized Blast, and her Ultimate paralyzes the monster.
adventurers.descriptionFa: توپچی کوچولوی بازی که بیشتر نبرد را توی هوا می‌گذراند! با Bouncy Dash می‌پرد بالا و رگبار می‌بندد، با لایه‌های تمرکز شلیک فشرده‌اش را قوی می‌کند و اولتیمیتش هیولا را فلج می‌کند تا تیم راحت کارش را تمام کند.

adventurers.description: Relentless Demon Mode combos. His Ultimate plants a bone-spike mark: the monster takes +13% dragon damage, and even more at the spiked part.
adventurers.descriptionFa: شیطان تیغه‌های دوقلو! در حالت شیطانی (Demon Mode) بی‌وقفه کمبو می‌زند و اولتیمیتش یک نشان استخوانی روی هیولا می‌کارد که آسیب اژدهای دریافتی‌اش را ۱۳٪ بیشتر می‌کند؛ اگر دقیقاً همان نقطه را بزنی، بیشتر هم می‌شود.

ultimate.description: Plants the bone-spike mark for 30 s.

adventurers.description: Heat switches his stance between Charged Slash and the swift Fleeting Star; Perfect Guards feed the fireworks of Grand Performance. Free SR.
adventurers.descriptionFa: هنرمند آتش‌بازی با گریت‌سورد که جزو SRهای رایگان است. گرمای (Heat) بدنش سبک جنگیدنش را عوض می‌کند و گاردهای بی‌نقصش، نمایش بزرگ Grand Performance را تغذیه می‌کنند.

ultimate.description: Firework bombs that daze and suppress; up to 3 charges.

adventurers.description: Dance-like spinning blades. Hits fill her Demon Gauge — combo hits grant even more — and her Ultimate restrains the monster with traps. Free SR.
adventurers.descriptionFa: رقصندهٔ تیغه‌ها که جزو SRهای رایگان است. چرخش‌هایش نوار شیطانی را پر می‌کند و اولتیمیتش با تله، هیولا را سر جایش میخکوب می‌کند تا تیم حسابی از خجالتش دربیاید. البته تله روی اژدهایان ارشد (Elder Dragon) جواب نمی‌دهد.

ultimate.description: Suppression; her Buddy sets pitfall traps (4 s control). Does not work on Elder Dragons.

adventurers.description: The premier all-round buffer (Guild Shop: 24,000 Emblems). Her squadmate skill charges allies' Ultimates, and her Ultimate raises the whole squad's Elemental Critical Damage — she fits every team.
adventurers.descriptionFa: بهترین پشتیبان بازی که از فروشگاه گیلد با ۲۴ هزار مدال می‌گیری‌اش. بودنش یعنی اولتیمیت هم‌تیمی‌ها زودتر شارژ می‌شود و اولتیمیت خودش آسیب بحرانی المنتال کل تیم را بالا می‌برد. خلاصه، هر تیمی با Haze بهتر می‌شود.

skills.description: Archdemon follow-up; activates her Serpent's Shadow trait.

ultimate.description: Squad-wide Elemental Critical Damage buff once her mark bursts; stronger after she lands 12 hits.

adventurers.description: Medic-archer. Every shot loads a Catalyst Coating that raises the monster's spore level; Detonating Shot ruptures them, and her Ultimate is a big heal plus a damage buff. Free SR.
adventurers.descriptionFa: دکتر تیم با کمان که جزو SRهای رایگان است! هر تیرش یک لایه اسپور روی هیولا می‌نشاند و شلیک انفجاری‌اش همه را با هم می‌ترکاند. اولتیمیتش هم یک درمان حسابی برای کل تیم است، هم باف آسیب.

ultimate.description: Large heal to all Adventurers in radius + damage buff + regen for 10 s.

adventurers.description: A feasting swordsman. Gathering Feast, Craving and Ravenous Energy together makes him Well-fed and supercharges his kit; his Ultimate buffs squad fire damage with ailment immunity. Free SR.
adventurers.descriptionFa: شمشیرزن شکمویی که جزو SRهای رایگان است! وقتی هر سه انرژی ضیافتش با هم جمع شوند، «سیر» می‌شود و کل کیتش قوی‌تر کار می‌کند. اولتیمیتش هم آسیب آتشی تیم را بالا می‌برد، هم همه را در برابر وضعیت‌های منفی مصون می‌کند.

ultimate.description: All allies: fire damage up + ailment immunity for 10 s.

weaknesses: Needs all three energies for full power

adventurers.description: Tank-support. Attacks build Battle Spirit (Resolve); spending 3 fires Earthrend Finisher — massive damage plus a squad shield. Her Ultimate shields everyone and grants affinity.
adventurers.descriptionFa: دیوار تیم! با نیزه‌اش هم تانک است هم پشتیبان. حمله‌هایش روح نبرد (Resolve) جمع می‌کند و با سه واحد از آن، Earthrend Finisher را می‌زند: آسیب سنگین به‌علاوهٔ سپر برای کل تیم. اولتیمیتش هم به همه سپر و شانس ضربهٔ بحرانی می‌دهد.

skills.description: Perfect Guard builds to Reprisal Finisher.

ultimate.description: Squad shield + 8% affinity for 30 s; instantly grants 3 Battle Spirit.

adventurers.description: You — the hunter you create at the start of the story, and the most flexible Adventurer in Aesoland. The Fated Adventurer is the only one who can wield all 8 weapon types (including the Charge Blade, which no one else can use), switch freely between the Assault, Disruptor and Support classes — which also changes your Ultimate — and take any element through your weapon. Your passive turns affinity and elemental crit into raw damage, Pioneer Follow-Up strikes whenever the monster is suppressed, and every Insight unlocks free through Trial Expeditions instead of recruitment. The catch: bring the wrong element, or a squad without elemental resonance, and your damage falls off. Your power is preparation.
adventurers.descriptionFa: این یکی خودتی — هانتری که اول بازی می‌سازی‌اش و قوی‌ترین شروع ممکن رو داری. تنها ادونچرری‌ای هستی که هر هشت سلاح رو دست می‌گیری (از جمله چارج بلید که هیچ‌کس دیگه‌ای بلدش نیست)، کلاست رو آزادانه بین Assault و Disruptor و Support عوض می‌کنی — و با کلاس، اولتیمیتت هم عوض می‌شه — و المنتت رو از سلاحت می‌گیری. پسیوت Affinity و کریت المنتال رو مستقیم به دمیج تبدیل می‌کنه، Pioneer Follow-Up هر بار که هیولا سرکوب بشه یه ضربهٔ سنگین می‌زنه، و همهٔ Insightهات رو به‌جای گاچا، رایگان از Trial Expedition باز می‌کنی. نقطه‌ضعفت هم معلومه: المنت اشتباه یا تیم بدون رزونانس المنتال، دمیجت رو می‌خوابونه؛ قدرت تو، توی آماده‌سازیه.
strengths: Only adventurer who can use all 8 weapon types
Freely switches class (Assault/Disruptor/Support) — and with it his Ultimate — plus any element via weapon
Only Charge Blade user in the game
Uses every Heavy Bowgun ammo type, so he can fight at any range
All Insights unlock free through progression (Trial Expeditions) — no duplicates or banners needed

Free from the start and top-ranked: SSS with Heavy Bowgun on GameWith's character tier list (joint best with Midori); Game8 rates him Damage ★★★★★ / Versatility ★★★★★ among the top main on-field characters
weaknesses: Damage drops without an elemental weapon and elemental resonance in the squad (repeated on every GameWith build page)
No personal weapon kit — named Adventurers' unique skills and ultimates stay exclusive to them
His exclusive Charge Blade has the steepest learning curve of all 8 weapons (Game8 Ease ★★)
Per-weapon weaknesses are inherited from the weapon itself (e.g. Dual Blades: short reach, no guard, Demon Mode stamina drain; Bow: heavy stamina costs)

typeUltimates.effect: Fire 4 sharp projectiles from the slinger that rapidly spread out in front; each projectile deals 3 instances of piercing damage.
Fire specially crafted ammo from the slinger that detonates on impact into a blinding flash, knocking flying monsters out of the sky and dazing them to inflict Suppression.
Launch a medicine pack from the slinger, detonating on impact and spreading a healing mist that continuously recovers health for Adventurers in range (mist lasts 12s per GameWith JP).

signatureTraits: Masterful Adventurer — Having mastered all weapon arts during past adventures, you can use any type of weapon.
Daytime Hunter — When adventurers in the squad carve during the day, carving speed increases by 50% (cannot stack with traits of the exact same effect).

Pioneer Follow-Up (209%) — Activates when the Main Adventurer or any ultimate suppresses the monster, following up and dealing heavy sever, ammo, or blunt damage depending on the equipped weapon type. Can only trigger once every 40s.

Core passive — When the Fated Adventurer activates any elemental specialization, for every 1% affinity, damage increases by 0.25%, up to 22.5%. And when the Fated Adventurer's elemental critical damage exceeds 20%, each additional 1% elemental critical damage increases damage by 0.5%.
adventurers.weaponSystemNote: Switch weapons any time by tapping the weapon on the equipment screen — you start with one weapon of every type, so all 8 can be tried without crafting. Switch class from the Adventurer screen, the edit-squad screen or the multiplayer lobby. No source documents switching weapons mid-hunt: plan your weapon before the hunt starts.
weaponSystemPoints: Only adventurer who can switch weapon type AND class/type AND element — everyone else is locked to one weapon, one class, one preferred element.
Only Charge Blade user at launch — no named Adventurer uses the Charge Blade; it was not in the betas and joined at launch.
With the Heavy Bowgun, the Fated Adventurer can use EVERY ammo type; named HBG Adventurers cannot.

He has no unique weapon kit of his own: the weapon movesets he plays are the Fated versions (GameWith/Game8 publish them separately because named Adventurers' personal skills modify the same weapons differently).
adventurers.insightSummary: Fated's progression system. Insights are unlocked with points earned through play — all of them can be unlocked for free (no gacha duplicates); Trial Expedition first-clears award Insight boxes covering every weapon type (150-stage challenge). Shared by all three Types: Power Charge (Ultimate charge +5%); Hunting Spirit (Damage +5%); Protection (Physical damage taken −8%); Harmony (All elemental resistances +8%). Assault picks: Monsoon — on Ultimate, skill damage +10% and part damage +10% for 20s; Cyclone — each part break gives +5% skill damage, stacking up to 5 times. Disruptor picks: Dust Storm — Ultimate daze duration +50%, dazed monsters take +10% damage; Soother — +15% skill damage vs enraged monsters. Support picks: Rising Spirit — Ultimate healing smoke also restores 10 stamina/s and +10% affinity; Battle Sustenance — healing smoke continuously revives downed Adventurers.
adventurers.insightSummaryFa: Insight سیستم پیشرفت اختصاصی Fated ـه: با امتیازهایی که از بازی‌کردن می‌گیری باز می‌شن و همه‌شون رایگان‌ان — نه گاچا می‌خوان، نه نسخهٔ تکراری کاراکتر. اولین پاک‌سازی هر مرحلهٔ Trial Expedition (چالش ۱۵۰ مرحله‌ای) جعبهٔ Insight برای همهٔ نوع‌های سلاح می‌ده. هر تایپ (Assault و Disruptor و Support) جفت Insight خودش رو داره و چند Insight هم بین هر سه تایپ مشترکه.
insightHighlights: Great Sword — Focused Charge ★★★★★ — charging 20% faster; skill damage +5%/+10%/+20% by charge level
Dual Blades — Enhanced Stamina ★★★★★ — Demon Mode stamina use halved, skill damage +15%
Hammer — Strike Frenzy ★★★★★ — Big Bang +30% skill damage, one fewer precise tap, Big Bang IV can loop
Lance — Counter Expert ★★★★★ — guard window 50% longer, counters +20% skill damage
Charge Blade — Vial Combustion ★★★★★ — vial explosions +20% damage
Heavy Bowgun — Internal Ammo ★★★★★ — Wyvernheart and gunpowder start fully stocked
Bow — Martial Harmony ★★★★★ — Rapid Fire/Power Shot/Slide Shot +50% range and 50% less stamina
adventurers.bestClassNote: Disruptor, per Game8's dedicated best-class article (suppressions create free damage windows; best long-term damage). GameWith adds that types differ little in performance: Assault is easier damage when you control him; Disruptor or Support when he is a teammate — and its per-weapon pages usually recommend Disruptor for a main-controlled Fated.
adventurers.bestStartersNote: Heavy Bowgun first (top pick in GameWith SS tier and Game8's best-weapon statement; safe distance, all ammo, beginner-friendly), Long Sword as the melee starter (low barrier, very forgiving Foresight Slash parry — Game8).

monsters.description: A fanged wyvern that swallows prey whole and fights with its swollen belly.
monsters.descriptionFa: مارمولک گنده‌ای که شکارش را درسته قورت می‌دهد و با همان شکم بادکرده به تو حمله می‌کند!

monsters.description: A bird wyvern that digs up rocks — and even crystal shards — to shield itself and smash hunters.
monsters.descriptionFa: مرغ‌دزد بازیگوشی که سنگ و خرده‌کریستال از زمین می‌کند تا هم سپر بگیرد، هم توی سرت بکوبد.

monsters.description: A bird wyvern that sprays poison from its mouth and tail; watch its bulging throat sac.
monsters.descriptionFa: پرندهٔ سم‌پاشی که از دهان و دمش سم می‌پاشد؛ وقتی کیسهٔ گلویش باد کرد، یعنی وقت کنار کشیدن است.

monsters.description: Pack leader of the Girros; its paralyzing fangs command the whole swarm.
monsters.descriptionFa: رئیس گلهٔ گیروس‌هاست؛ نیش فلج‌کننده‌اش کافی است تا کل گله به فرمانش برقصند.

monsters.description: A brute wyvern that charges head-first and cakes itself in mud armour.
monsters.descriptionFa: کله‌خراب صحرا که با سر شیرجه می‌زند و خودش را با گِل می‌پوشاند تا زره بسازد.
monsters.notes: While mud-covered, its top weakness becomes Water ★3.

monsters.description: A mud-dwelling piscine wyvern that ambushes from swamps and sludge.
monsters.descriptionFa: ماهی‌ویورن گل‌آلودی که در مرداب کمین می‌کند و از زیر گِل بیرون می‌پرد.
monsters.notes: While mud-covered, its top weakness becomes Water ★3.

monsters.description: A brute wyvern with a nose crest and fire breath when its throat glows.
monsters.descriptionFa: تی‌رکس بازی با تاج روی بینی؛ وقتی گلویش سرخ و درخشان شد، یعنی نفس آتشین در راه است.

monsters.description: A gliding fanged wyvern that builds static charge in its fur and tail.
monsters.descriptionFa: سنجاب پرندهٔ برقی که در خز و دمش بار ساکن جمع می‌کند و دور درخت‌ها می‌چرخد.
monsters.notes: No ★3 weakness — Fire, Water and Ice are all ★2.

monsters.description: The Queen of the Land — a flying wyvern whose tail flips deliver poison.
monsters.descriptionFa: ملکهٔ زمین؛ دم سمّی‌اش با یک چرخش ناگهانی، هانترهای حواس‌پرت را غافلگیر می‌کند.

monsters.description: A cherry-blossom Rathian subspecies with a harder shell and fiercer tail.
monsters.descriptionFa: خواهر صورتی و سرسخت‌تر راثیان؛ پوسته‌اش سخت‌تر و دم‌بازی‌اش خشن‌تر است.
monsters.notes: Weakness data is single-source for now.

monsters.description: King of the Skies — a flying wyvern that rules from above with fire breath and poisonous talons.
monsters.descriptionFa: پادشاه آسمان‌ها که با نفس آتش و چنگال‌های سمّی از بالا فرمان می‌راند. بال‌هایش را بشکن تا زمین‌گیر شود.
monsters.notes: Thunder is a secondary weakness (star rating not yet published). Habitats: Outlands, Great Sand Sea, Misty Forest.

monsters.description: The desert tyrant. It burrows under the sand and erupts beneath hunters; deafening roars precede its charges.
monsters.descriptionFa: ستمگر صحرا که زیر شن نقب می‌زند و درست زیر پایت فوران می‌کند؛ نعره‌اش کرکننده است.

monsters.description: A female Diablos in breeding season — black, faster and far more aggressive.
monsters.descriptionFa: دیابلوس ماده در فصل جفت‌گیری؛ سیاه، تندتر و خیلی عصبانی‌تر از نوع معمولی.
monsters.notes: Weakness data is single-source for now.

monsters.description: A bird wyvern that flashes blinding light from its head crest to stun its prey.
monsters.descriptionFa: پرندهٔ نورافکنی که با فلاش خیره‌کنندهٔ تاج سرش چشم هانترها را می‌زند و گیجشان می‌کند.

monsters.description: A bat-like flying wyvern that inflates its neck pouch to float and drift on the wind.
monsters.descriptionFa: خفاش پشمالوی بامزه‌ای که کیسهٔ گردنش را باد می‌کند و روی باد سر می‌خورد.

monsters.description: The graceful apex of the highlands; shrieking ice winds trail its dives.
monsters.descriptionFa: ملکهٔ یخی بلندی‌ها؛ شیرجه‌هایش با باد سرد و جیغ‌مانند همراه است.

monsters.description: A relentless fanged wyvern whose claws inflict bleeding; it drags carcasses back to its lair.
monsters.descriptionFa: گرگ وحشی این دنیا؛ چنگال‌هایش زخم خونریزی‌دهنده می‌زنند و لاشه‌ها را به لانه‌اش می‌کشد.

monsters.description: A brute wyvern that rolls in a ball of bone and tar, ploughing through hunters.
monsters.descriptionFa: غلتک استخوانی که خودش را گلوله می‌کند و از روی هر چیزی که سر راهش باشد رد می‌شود.

monsters.description: An Elder Dragon wreathed in storms; its wind barrier deflects attacks until it is broken.
monsters.descriptionFa: اژدهای ارشد طوفان؛ دیوار بادش تا وقتی نشکند، بیشتر ضربه‌ها را پس می‌زند.
monsters.notes: Elder Dragon — traps do not work on it. Weakness is single-source for now.

monsters.description: The Eater of Elders — an Elder Dragon whose spikes regrow harder the longer the fight lasts.
monsters.descriptionFa: کابوس بقیهٔ اژدهایان ارشد! خارهایش هرچه نبرد طولانی‌تر شود، سخت‌تر و تیزتر بازمی‌رویند.
monsters.notes: Elemental weakness not yet published by databases — bring a balanced squad. Elder Dragon: traps do not work.

monsters.description: The flagship Elder Dragon of Aesoland. Its crystal horns channel fire, and freshly formed crystals shatter under repeated hits.
monsters.descriptionFa: غول آخر ایسولند؛ شاخ‌های کریستالی‌اش آتش شلیک می‌کنند و کریستال‌های تازه‌اش با ضربه‌های پی‌درپی خرد می‌شوند.
monsters.notes: Elder Dragon — cannot be captured and traps do not work. Farmed in the Apex Challenge after Chapter 6; its materials craft Apex Weapons with a player-chosen element.

monsters.description: The Radiant form of Great Jagras — a powered-up variant with shifted elemental weaknesses.
monsters.descriptionFa: فرم رادیانت و تقویت‌شدهٔ Great Jagras؛ قوی‌تر از نوع معمولی و با ضعف‌های المنتال متفاوت.
monsters.notes: Radiant form.

monsters.description: The Radiant form of Kulu-Ya-Ku — a powered-up variant with shifted elemental weaknesses.
monsters.descriptionFa: فرم رادیانت و تقویت‌شدهٔ Kulu-Ya-Ku؛ قوی‌تر از نوع معمولی و با ضعف‌های المنتال متفاوت.
monsters.notes: Radiant form.

monsters.description: The Radiant form of Pukei-Pukei — a powered-up variant with shifted elemental weaknesses.
monsters.descriptionFa: فرم رادیانت و تقویت‌شدهٔ Pukei-Pukei؛ قوی‌تر از نوع معمولی و با ضعف‌های المنتال متفاوت.
monsters.notes: Radiant form.

monsters.description: The Radiant form of Great Girros — a powered-up variant with shifted elemental weaknesses.
monsters.descriptionFa: فرم رادیانت و تقویت‌شدهٔ Great Girros؛ قوی‌تر از نوع معمولی و با ضعف‌های المنتال متفاوت.
monsters.notes: Radiant form. Radiant form flips the base weakness from Water to Dragon.

monsters.description: The Radiant form of Barroth — a powered-up variant with shifted elemental weaknesses.
monsters.descriptionFa: فرم رادیانت و تقویت‌شدهٔ Barroth؛ قوی‌تر از نوع معمولی و با ضعف‌های المنتال متفاوت.
monsters.notes: Radiant form.

monsters.description: The Radiant form of Anjanath — a powered-up variant with shifted elemental weaknesses.

teamComps.strategy: Unify on Fire for elemental resonance: Midori leads, Ryunosuke amps the squad's fire, a Fire Fated fills DPS, Haze charges everyone's Ultimates. Swap: Raya for Ryunosuke.
teamComps.strategyFa: ایده ساده است: همه آتش! Midori ستارهٔ تیم است، Ryunosuke آسیب آتشی همه را تقویت می‌کند، Fated با سلاح آتشی کمبودها را پر می‌کند و Haze اولتیمیت‌ها را زودتر شارژ می‌کند. اگر Ryunosuke را نداری، Raya جایگزین خوبی است.

teamComps.strategy: Pepper pressures from the air, a Water Fated holds the front, Madelyn heals and detonates spores, Haze buffs. Swap: Arkaya or Ouyang Varen for Haze.
teamComps.strategyFa: Pepper از هوا فشار می‌آورد، Fated با المنت آب جلوی تیم می‌ایستد، Madelyn هم درمان می‌کند هم با اسپورهایش آسیب انفجاری می‌زند و Haze به همه باف می‌دهد. به جای Haze می‌توانی Arkaya یا Ouyang Varen را هم امتحان کنی.

teamComps.strategy: Luka snipes with Thunder Coatings, Luxheart dazes with fireworks, a Thunder Fated adds Great Sword breaks, Haze keeps Ultimates cycling.
teamComps.strategyFa: Luka از راه دور با پوشش رعدی هیولا را سوراخ‌سوراخ می‌کند، Luxheart با آتش‌بازی‌اش گیجش می‌کند، Fated رعدی با گریت‌سورد نقاط را می‌شکند و Haze چرخهٔ اولتیمیت‌ها را تند نگه می‌دارد.

teamComps.strategy: Rhodes is the Ice core — pair him with a Hammer Fated for part breaks, Haze for buffs and Arkaya for squad shields.
teamComps.strategyFa: چون Rhodes تنها ادونچرر یخی بازی است، تیم یخی دور او چیده می‌شود: Fated با چکش برای شکستن نقاط، Haze برای باف و Arkaya برای سپر تیمی.

teamComps.strategy: Arkaya tanks and shields, Keres marks the monster for +13% dragon damage taken, Pyro cashes out with Fervor burst, Haze buffs everyone. Also works with Pyro as the controlled main.
teamComps.strategyFa: Arkaya جلو می‌ایستد و سپر می‌دهد، Keres هیولا را نشان می‌کند تا ۱۳٪ آسیب اژدهای بیشتری بخورد، Pyro با انفجار شورش کار را تمام می‌کند و Haze همه را تقویت می‌کند. این تیم با Pyro به‌عنوان شخصیت اصلی هم عالی جواب می‌دهد.

teamComps.strategy: All free units: a Fire Fated leads, Raya and Ouyang Varen (free SRs) cover damage and defence, Madelyn heals. A solid first squad for every early hunt.
teamComps.strategyFa: تیم شروع کاملاً رایگان: Fated آتشی لیدر است، Raya و Ouyang Varen (هر دو SR رایگان) آسیب و دفاع را پوشش می‌دهند و Madelyn درمان می‌کند. برای شکارهای اول بازی، از این بهتر نمی‌شود.

steps.action: Build your Spirit Gauge by holding the Skill 1 button, then release for a forward slash that raises your Spirit Level.
Activate Skill 2 (Blade of Truth) to raise your Spirit Gauge Level. Repeat step 1 or land Basic Attacks until you reach Level 3.
Use Perfect Evade at every opportunity to reach Level 3 faster, then use Skill 2 (Blade of Truth) again for another level.
Trigger all squad buffs and enemy debuffs.
Cast Midori's Ultimate if available.
Chain Skill 3 (Moment of Insight) three times, timed during enemy attack animations to parry — press while the circle is in the red area for even more damage.

rotations.tips: Midori's rotation is about building and levelling her Spirit Gauge as fast as possible, then cashing out with her Ultimate and the Skill 3 chain.
rotations.tipsFa: کلید کار میدوری نوار روحشه: با نگه‌داشتن اسکیل ۱ و جاخالی‌های تمیز سریع برسونش به سطح ۳، بعد باف‌های تیم و دباف‌ها رو فعال کن و اولتیمیت و زنجیرهٔ اسکیل ۳ رو روی هیولا خالی کن. اسکیل ۳ رو وسط انیمیشن حملهٔ هیولا بزن تا پری بسازه.

steps.action: Tap Basic Attack once for a quick Charged Slash without charging it. What comes next depends on what the monster does.
Read the monster: a quick Strong Charged Slash if a blockable hit is coming; charge to the orange bar if it stays idle; Heat Tackle (Skill 1) to parry an unblockable attack.
(Optional) If the monster moves out of range while you charge Fortifying Slash, use Reckless Charge (Skill 2) to reposition and keep the charge.
At Fervor Level 3, hold Fortifying Slash (Skill 3) to max charge — or let the monster's hit finish the charge — then release for massive airborne damage.

rotations.tips: If you fail a parry with Heat Tackle, Pyro's Fervor Level resets to 1. To protect your Fervor, use Reckless Charge Slash instead.
rotations.tipsFa: پایرو با خوندن حرکت هیولا زندگی می‌کنه؛ اگه پریِ Heat Tackle رو خراب کنی، سطح Fervor برمی‌گرده به ۱. وقتی هیولا آرومه شارژ رو تا نوار نارنجی نگه دار، وقتی نزدیکه با پری جواب بده.

steps.action: Use Thunderous Spin (Skill 1) to deal damage and gain a Thunder Coating.
Precise-Tap Thunderous Spin (Skill 1) again to reposition and gain another Thunder Coating.
Use Arc Slash (Skill 2) to reposition, gain a Thunder Coating and regain stamina.
Repeat Skills 1 and 2 until you hold 4 Thunder Coatings.
Use Swift Volley (Skill 3) to expend a Thunder Coating.
Precise-Tap Swift Volley (Skill 3) three more times to expend all Thunder Coatings.
Repeat the rotation.

rotations.tips: Luka's loop: Thunderous Spin generates Thunder Coatings, Arc Slash tops up stamina, and once four Coatings are stored, Swift Volley spends them one after another.
rotations.tipsFa: چرخهٔ لوکا ساده‌ست: اسکیل ۱ و ۲ رو بچرخون تا چهار پوشش رعدی جمع بشه، بعد همه رو با اسکیل ۳ خالی کن. اسکیل ۲ استامینا رو هم برمی‌گردونه، پس هر وقت نفست گرفت همون رو بزن.

steps.action: Fire Basic Attacks until the magazine is empty to secure 2 points of Concentration.
Use Bouncy Dash toward the monster to instantly reload and launch into the air.
While airborne, fire Basic Attacks twice, followed immediately by your Burst, Aerial Blast.
Before Aerial Blast's recoil pushes you out of range, cast Bouncy Dash back toward the monster.
Fire two Basic Attacks again, followed by another Aerial Blast.
Execute Skill 1 to perform an Aerial Slam, so you don't land too far from the monster.

rotations.tips: Pepper's rotation keeps her airborne: empty the magazine for Concentration, dash to reload mid-air, then chain Aerial Blasts — the Aerial Slam keeps her in range instead of landing far away.
rotations.tipsFa: پپر باید توی هوا بمونه: خشاب رو خالی کن تا تمرکز جمع بشه، با Bouncy Dash بپر و ریلود کن، دو شلیک و Aerial Blast؛ قبل از اینکه پس‌زنی تو رو دور کنه، دوباره داش بزن و برگرد.

steps.action: Always lock on to the monster's weak spot at the start of a fight.
You start with zero Demon Gauge — use Wolf Howl (Skill 3) and Chain Slash (Basic Attack) to fill it quickly to 40% and above.
Enter Demon Mode with Lupine Demon Mode (Skill 1), or parry with Evasive Pang (Skill 2) to enter it immediately and perform Bone Piercer right away.
Once in Demon Mode, use Wolf Howl (Skill 3) three times — or parry with Evasive Pang (Skill 2) — to activate Bone Piercer.
(Optional) Weave Chain Slash (Basic Attacks) in between Wolf Howl activations.
When the monster is about to be immobilised by any means, use Keres' Ultimate to inflict a debuff on its weak spot.
Repeat the rotation.

rotations.tips: Whenever you use Bone Piercer you can move freely in mid-air to redirect the damage — especially when it isn't hitting the monster's weak spot.
rotations.tipsFa: اول قفل روی نقطه‌ضعف. نوار دیمون رو با اسکیل ۳ و حملهٔ معمولی از ۴۰٪ رد کن، وارد دیمون مود شو و Bone Piercer رو فعال کن. اولتیمیت رو نگه دار برای وقتی هیولا داره بی‌حرکت می‌شه.

steps.action: Begin with a standard Basic Attack — weapon readied or as a draw attack.
Follow it up with Starlight Burst I (Skill 2) to generate your first Heat stack.
Use a modified Basic Attack next.
Use Starlight Burst II (Skill 2) to generate two Heat stacks.
Use your modified Basic Attack again to continue the combo.
Use Starlight Burst III (Skill 2) to generate the last three Heat stacks and reach the cap.
Use Grand Performance (Skill 3) to expend all Heat stacks and deal massive damage to all surrounding enemies.
Repeat as necessary.

rotations.tips: Luxheart's rotation revolves around stacking Heat whenever he can, then expending it all with Grand Performance.
rotations.tipsFa: لوکس‌هارت یعنی مدیریت استک گرما: بین هر Starlight Burst یه حملهٔ معمولیِ تغییریافته بزن تا به سقف استک برسی، بعد Grand Performance همه رو یه‌جا به دمیج تبدیل می‌کنه.

steps.action: Lock onto an enemy's weak point and spam Chain Dance (Skill 3) and Basic Attacks to enter Demon Mode.
Execute 3 hits of Chain Dance (Skill 3) and end with Basic Attacks for more hits and access to Rising Whirling Dance.
Parry attacks using Whirling Dance (Skill 2) whenever possible — successful parries also lead to Rising Whirling Dance.
Build up your Ultimate and use it when available.
Use available squadmate skills and continue spamming Chain Dance.
Repeat the rotation.

rotations.tips: Whirling Dance (Skill 2) must be active first — only then does tapping the skill again parry incoming attacks.
rotations.tipsFa: رایا با اسپم Chain Dance وارد دیمون مود می‌شه؛ نکته‌اش اینه که Whirling Dance اول باید فعال باشه تا ضربهٔ دومش پری بشه. پریِ موفق یعنی راه Rising Whirling Dance بازه.

steps.action: Parry an attack using Defensive Maneuver (Skill 2) to get a stack of Sharpness.
Execute 3 Basic Attacks twice for 2 more Sharpness stacks.
Tap Piercing Thrust (Skill 3).
Immediately use Defensive Maneuver (Skill 2) to follow up and continue dealing damage.
Build up your Ultimate and use it when available.

rotations.tips: Ouyang Varen's Sharpness stacks show in his weapon's colour — always aim for max stacks, when the weapon glows red.
rotations.tipsFa: وظیفه‌ات خوندن حملهٔ هیولاست: با اسکیل ۲ پری کن تا استک Sharpness بگیری؛ وقتی سلاحت سرخ شد یعنی سه استک کامل شده و وقتشه خرجشون کنی.

steps.action: Use Basic Attack 3 times to get Catalyst Coating stacks.
Use Spore Adhesion (Skill 3) to deal damage and attach 5 spores. Repeat to get 10 spores on the enemy.
Perform Slide Shot (Skill 1) to consume all spore stacks, deal damage, and gain Violet Plume Burst.
Alternate Basic Attacks and Catalyst Burst (Skill 2) to deal enhanced damage while also applying spore stacks.
Use Slide Shot (Skill 1) again to regain Violet Plume Burst. Repeat Basic Attacks and Catalyst Burst (Skill 2).
Build up your Ultimate and use it when available.

rotations.tips: Madelyn deals damage through spore and stamina management, but she shines most as a squadmate — her kit feeds the whole squad.
rotations.tipsFa: مادلین با اسپور بازی می‌کنه: ده اسپور روی هیولا بچسبون، با اسکیل ۱ همه رو مصرف کن و بینش با تناوب حمله و اسکیل ۲ اسپورها رو تازه نگه دار. جایگاه اصلیش توی تیم پشتیبانیه تا تک‌روی.

steps.action: Start with a full Basic Attack combo — or three Basic Attacks and a Sidestep Slash — then Spirit Slash (Skill 1) and Feasting (Skill 1) to raise your Spirit Gauge by 1 and enter the Feasting state.
If the monster attacks mid-combo, counter with Inebriated (Skill 2) to gain 1 Spirit Gauge level and end in the Feasting state.
Use Inebriated: Torrent (Skill 2) during the Feasting state to gain the Craving stack.
Return to the Feasting state with Feasting (Skill 1), then activate Linear Slash (Skill 1) to gain the Feast stack.
Return to Feasting once more with Feasting (Skill 1), then activate Piercing Flavors (Skill 3) for the final Ravenous stack and the Well-fed state.
(Optional) If your Ultimate is ready, use it right after gaining the Well-fed state for more fire damage during its duration.
During Well-fed, use Linear Slash (Skill 1) to deal damage, sometimes switching to Inebriated: Torrent to refresh your Spirit Gauge regeneration.
Once you have max-level Spirit Gauge, use Piercing Flavors (Skill 3) during the Feasting state for even more rupture damage.
Repeat until you exit the Well-fed state.

rotations.tips: After gaining all three unique stacks, Ryunosuke enters the Well-fed state, which adds 3 hits to all of his rupture damage.
rotations.tipsFa: ریونوسکه سه استک متفاوت می‌خواد: Craving و Feast و Ravenous؛ هر سه که جمع شد وارد حالت Well-fed می‌شی و ضربه‌های rupture سه‌تایی می‌شن. ترتیب اسکیل‌ها رو قاطی نکن — کل چرخه همینه.

steps.action: (Optional) If you have room for a Driving Assault, use it to perform a Seismic Rupture and start the fight with 1 Battle Spirit stack.
Use Thrusts (Basic Attack) while waiting for the monster to attack.
Answer with the correct Boulder Stance (Skill 1): if you are mid-thrust, use it immediately; if the attack is predictable, stance before it lands and Basic Attack through it.
Continue fishing for monster attacks and react with the appropriate guard to gain more Battle Spirit stacks.
Once you have 3 Battle Spirit stacks, spend them immediately to deal high damage and shield yourself and your party.
(Optional) If the enemy runs away, use Driving Assault to chase it.
Once the enemy is down, use Relentless Assault (Skill 3) to deal constant damage while gaining Battle Spirit.
Repeat the rotation.

rotations.tips: Boulder Stance is Arkaya's only guard skill — a perfect guard followed by a Basic Attack (Reprisal Finisher) gains 1 Battle Spirit stack.
rotations.tipsFa: آرکایا تانکِ واکنشی‌ه: حمله نکن، منتظر بمون و حملهٔ هیولا رو با Boulder Stance درست جواب بده تا Battle Spirit جمع بشه؛ سه استک که شد، هم دمیج داری هم سپر برای کل تیم.

steps.action: Approach the enemy and use Charge (Skill 1) to enter the charge state.
Once you hit the third charge level, use the Basic Attack button to perform a Big Bang attack, generating Steam energy.
Perform a Basic Attack twice to completely fill the Steam energy gauge.
Tap Charge (Skill 1) twice to enter the charge state and switch to Skating Charge state.
Once you reach charge level 3, tap the Basic Attack button to execute the Spinning Big Bang attack.
Press the Basic Attack button once the Core Energy gauge is full, ending the Spinning Big Bang with a downward smash.
Use Steam Skyrender (Skill 3) to deal massive damage, expending all of your Core Energy.
Perform a Basic Attack immediately after Steam Skyrender to perform a Spinning Slam.

rotations.tips: Rhodes's playstyle revolves around generating Steam energy, converting it into Core Energy, and spending it on his strongest attack, Steam Skyrender.
rotations.tipsFa: رودز یعنی مدیریت دو نوار: اول بخار رو با شارژ و Big Bang پر کن، بعد انرژی هسته رو با Skating Charge؛ وقتی هسته پر شد Steam Skyrender رو بزن و بلافاصله با یه حملهٔ معمولی Spinning Slam رو وصل کن.

steps.action: Begin by activating Demon Mode (Skill 1) and start moving to your target.
Use Waning Moon (Skill 3) to deal damage to your target and start filling up your Demon Gauge.
Follow it up with all three hits of Circling Chain Slash (Skill 2) by tapping it three times.
Use Waning Moon (Skill 3) again — this should trigger Archdemon Mode if all hits landed.
Activate Archdemon Mode, then execute Crimson Fang Slash (Skill 3) by dashing forward. Press it again for the follow-up series, and continue until your Demon Gauge is depleted.

rotations.tips: Haze's gameplay revolves around accumulating Demon Gauge to enter Archdemon Mode, then spending it through Crimson Fang Slash to deal damage and activate Serpent's Shadow.
rotations.tipsFa: هیز روی نوار دیمون سواره: دیمون مود، Waning Moon و سه ضربهٔ اسکیل ۲ باید همه بخورن تا Archdemon فعال بشه؛ اون‌جا Crimson Fang رو تا خالی‌شدن نوار ادامه بده.

steps.action: Tap Basic Attack twice: Charged Slash Lv1, then Strong Charged Slash Lv1 (weave Tackle in between if you don't have Focused Charge yet).
(Optional) Tackle (Skill 2) if the monster is about to attack or roar — it preserves your charge and prevents stagger.
Reach True Charged Slash and charge it to level 3.
At level 3 charge, Tackle twice (Skill 2) to perform Supreme Slash.
(Optional) During the Supreme Slash animation, use non-combat actions: switch targets, activate your Buddy, or allies' Ultimates.
Immediately follow with Leaping Wide Slash (Skill 3) — its damage scales with your charge — then reposition.
Repeat the rotation.

rotations.tips: Against agile monsters, don't charge the first two slashes — tap them quickly with a Tackle in between, charge only the third to Lv3, then double-Tackle into Supreme Slash. Guarding a hit and tapping Basic Attack skips straight to Strong Wide Slash.
rotations.tipsFa: جلوی هیولاهای چابک دو ضربهٔ اول رو شارژ نکن؛ سریع بزن و بینشون Tackle برو، فقط ضربهٔ سوم رو تا سطح ۳ شارژ کن و با دو Tackle وارد Supreme Slash شو. اگه حمله‌ای رو گارد گرفتی، یه ضربهٔ معمولی تو رو مستقیم می‌بره Strong Wide Slash.

steps.action: Full Basic Attack combo — or 3 Basic Attacks plus a Sidestep Slash — then Spirit Slash (Skill 1) ending in Spirit Roundslash to raise the Spirit Gauge by 1 level.
If the monster attacks mid-combo, counter with Foresight Slash (Skill 2) and end with Spirit Roundslash.
(Optional) After a Spirit Roundslash, hold Skill 2 to sheathe and use Iai Slash (Basic Attack) or Iai Spirit Slash (Skill 2) — best with Lingering Spirit unlocked.
Repeat until the Spirit Gauge reaches level 3 (Red).
Spirit Helm Breaker (Skill 3) to spend the gauge for massive rupture damage, then Spirit Armor Cleave (Skill 3).
(Optional) With the Fang Thrust Insight, use Spirit Armor Cleave again.
Repeat the rotation.

rotations.tips: The goal is a Red gauge before you spend it. Sidestep Slash builds extra gauge and skips the first Spirit Slash; a parried Iai Spirit Slash grants +1 level and can gain 2 levels at once, and Spirit Armor Cleave's opening parry can refund its cost.
rotations.tipsFa: هدفت اینه که قبل از خرج‌کردن، نوار روح رو قرمز کنی. Sidestep Slash نوار اضافه می‌سازه و Spirit Slash اول رو رد می‌کنه؛ پریِ موفق با Iai Spirit Slash یه سطح کامل می‌ده و گاهی دو سطح با هم. نوار قرمز که شد، Helm Breaker رو بزن و با Armor Cleave تمومش کن.

steps.action: Activate Demon Mode (Skill 1) and approach your target.
Use Dash Attack (Skill 2) to close the gap and deal damage.
Use Demon Mode: Blade Dance I (Skill 3) on your target.
Continue using Blade Dance (Skill 3) until you reach the third attack of the skill.
Once all attacks land and the Demon Gauge is completely filled, turn off Demon Mode and regain your stamina.

rotations.tips: Game8 presents this as the opener: refilling the gauge after the first full fill unlocks Archdemon Mode — tap Skill 1 at max gauge to exit Demon Mode into Archdemon. In Archdemon, Demon Flurry (Skill 3) chains back into Demon Mode's final Blade Dance hit; save it for toppled or trapped monsters, and manage stamina (Dash Juice) — Demon Mode drains it fast.
rotations.tipsFa: این اوپنر Fated با دابل بلیدزه: دیمون مود رو روشن کن، با داش بچسب و Blade Dance رو تا ضربهٔ سوم ادامه بده تا نوار کامل پر بشه. پرشدن دوم نوار، Archdemon رو باز می‌کنه؛ Demon Flurry رو برای هیولای افتاده یا گیرکرده نگه دار و حواست به استامینا باشه — دیمون مود زود خالیش می‌کنه.

steps.action: Lock on to the monster's head — Hammer only aims there.
Charge (Skill 1) up to charge level 3, closing the distance while charging (never get so close you eat a hit).
(Optional) With the Continuum Insight, stop at level 2 and use Charged Upswing (Basic Attack or Skill 1) for quick damage and stun.
After reaching level 3 charge, use Charge: Breakthrough (Skill 2) to enter Mighty Charge and raise the charge to level 4.
(Optional) Near the monster with plenty of stamina, use Spinning Bludgeon (Skill 3) for more blunt damage and stun first.
At level 4 charge, use Mighty Charged Smash (Basic Attack or Skill 1) — airborne, high blunt damage.
Repeat until the monster is knocked down.
Once the monster is immobilised, perform Big Bang (Skill 3) 4 times with precise timing to execute another Charged Smash.
Repeat the rotation.

rotations.tips: Hammer has no guard, parry or Unwavering — only movement while charging; Mighty Charge lets you dodge without losing your charge level. Precise timing = tap when the white circle overlaps the red circle (tap slightly early for input lag). Only weapon that applies Stun (Game8).
rotations.tipsFa: همر گارد و پری نداره؛ تنها دفاعت حرکت‌کردن موقع شارژه. تا وقتی دایرهٔ سفید روی دایرهٔ قرمز نیفتاده ضربه نزن و برای جبران لگ، یه ذره زودتر بزن. Mighty Charge می‌ذاره بدون از دست‌دادن سطح شارژ جاخالی بدی، و یادت باشه همر تنها سلاحیه که Stun می‌زنه — همیشه سر هیولا.

steps.action: (Optional) If you have room, open with Dash Attack (Skill 3) charged to level 3 before the fight for heavy damage.
Use Thrusts (Basic Attack) while waiting for the monster to attack.
After each 3 Thrusts, use Guard Counter (Skill 2) and perform a fully charged Counter-Thrust (Basic Attack).
Answer each attack with the correct guard: Guard (Skill 1) if you are mid-thrusts; Guard Counter (Skill 2) if the attack is predictable, aiming for a Counter Double Thrust.
Continue fishing for monster attacks and react with the appropriate guard skill.
(Optional) Against an unblockable or AoE attack, use Power Guard (Skill 2) to endure it — follow with Counter Cross Slash if near, or Dash Attack (Skill 3) if far.
Once the enemy is down, use Dash Attack (Skill 3) and run across its body, levelling the dash up to 3 for high damage.
Repeat the rotation.

rotations.tips: Game8 guard table: Guard (Skill 1) vs fast attacks (swipes, bites, tackles); Guard Counter (Skill 2) vs predictable/telegraphed attacks (tail sweeps, roars, ground pounds); Power Guard vs multi-hit / AoE / unblockable. Power Guard absorbs power levels (Purple → White → Yellow → Red) that transfer into Dash Attack levels.
rotations.tipsFa: لنس یعنی انتخاب گارد درست: حمله‌های سریع با Guard، حمله‌های قابل پیش‌بینی با Guard Counter و حمله‌های چندضربه‌ای و غیرقابل‌بلاک با Power Guard. هر سه Thrust یه کانتر شارژشده بزن و وقتی هیولا افتاد، Dash Attack سطح ۳ رو از روی بدنش رد کن.

steps.action: In Sword Mode, use your Basic Attack combo string until you fill up your Sword Energy gauge.
Once Sword Energy is full, press Skill 2 twice to transfer the energy to your sword and shield — stronger guard, additional damage procs, and no more bouncing off the monster.
Fill the Sword Energy gauge once again, then convert it to Phials (optionally top the gauge to full first for a smoother rotation later).
After obtaining your Phials, press Skill 3 twice, then cancel with Skill 2 before the Amped Element Discharge animation — this powers up and switches you to Axe Mode (Power Axe Mode).
Spam Basic Attacks in Axe Mode, holding the Basic Attack button while swinging to deal multiple instances of damage — stay in Axe Mode as long as you can.
During a long opening, activate Skill 3 to perform Axe: Ultra Amped Element Discharge, consuming your Phials for huge damage.
If you charged Sword Energy to full before switching to Axe Mode, press Skill 3 after the Ultra Amped Element Discharge to instantly charge your Phials again.
Swap back to Sword Mode to refill Sword Energy — or keep dealing damage in Axe Mode if you have the Guard Release Insight activated.

rotations.tips: Principles from the same page: use Guard Points to gain Phials (a Perfect Guard grants 3 Vials), Perfect Dodge while in Axe Mode, and cancel an Amped Discharge with Basic Attack to return to powered Axe Mode at the cost of 1 Phial. After a Perfect Evade in Axe Mode, hold Basic Attack for a charged multi-hit sweeping strike (consumes 1 Phial; another Perfect Evade restores it).
rotations.tipsFa: چرخهٔ چارج بلید Fated دو فازه: تو حالت شمشیر انرژی جمع کن، دوبار اسکیل ۲ برای تقویت شمشیر و سپر، بعد فیال‌ها رو پر کن و با لغو Discharge برو Power Axe. گارد پرفکت سه فیال می‌ده؛ تا وقتی بازه تو Axe Mode بمون و Ultra رو برای پنجره‌های طولانی نگه دار.

steps.action: Once you have unlocked Internal Ammo, start with a clip of Special Ammo first — ideally Slicing or Sticky Ammo, depending on the monster's resistance to stun.
After spending a clip, swap to Wyvernheart and empty your ammo to deal massive damage.
Swap back to Special Ammo and fire it for as long as you can.
Swap to Normal Ammo to replenish Special Ammo and your Wyvernheart gauge.
Aim for Perfect Guards to reload ammo quickly.

rotations.tips: Hold Skill 2 to swap between all ammo types. A Guard (Skill 1) timed just before a hit instantly reloads ALL loaded ammo — better than the passive auto-guard. Best Special Ammo: Slicing (primary) and Sticky. Hold Basic Attack to fire continuously; stay in Critical Distance (orange reticle). Only the Fated Adventurer can use every ammo type.
rotations.tipsFa: با Fated به همهٔ مهمات دسترسی داری: از Special Ammo شروع کن (Slicing برای دمیج، Sticky برای سر و استان)، خشاب که خالی شد Wyvernheart رو خالی کن و با Normal Ammo هر دو رو شارژ کن. گاردِ سرِ وقت همهٔ مهمات لودشده رو ریلود می‌کنه و همیشه تو فاصلهٔ بحرانی (نشانهٔ نارنجی) وایسا.

steps.action: Use Power Shot (Skill 2) four times to deal damage and reach the maximum charge level.
Use Slide Shot (Skill 1) to retain your charge level, then follow up with another Power Shot or a basic charged shot.
Use Rapid Fire (Basic Attack) four times to reach the maximum charge level, while waiting for your stamina to recover.
Use Slide Shot (Skill 1) to retain your charge level, then continue with either Power Shot or a Charged Shot, depending on your positioning.
Repeat as necessary until you have filled the Dragon Coating gauge.
Use Dragon Barrage: Rain (Skill 3) once the Dragon Coating gauge is full.

rotations.tips: Power Shot is the main gauge builder (most damage of the standard skills); Rapid Fire is filler while stamina recovers or when Power Shot is too dangerous. Dragon Barrage: Rain deals damage over a few seconds and mobile monsters can walk out of it — save it for toppled, exhausted or stationary targets.
rotations.tipsFa: Power Shot سازندهٔ اصلی نوار شارژه؛ چهار بار بزنش، با Slide Shot سطح شارژ رو نگه دار و موقع برگشتن استامینا با Rapid Fire پر کن. Dragon Barrage رو فقط روی هیولای افتاده، خسته یا ثابت خالی کن — هیولای متحرک از بارش تیرها بیرون می‌ره.
